sourceReview.notes: GST questions checked against India Code CGST Act consolidated as on 11 June 2026; Constitution against Legislative Department text; Meghalaya facts against Government state/district profiles; current affairs against dated Meghalaya releases; environment laws/rules against India Code, MoEFCC and CPCB. Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 were checked and the superseded 2016 Rules were not used. CBIC Instruction No. 02/2026-GST dated 30 October 2026 was also reviewed. It is addressed to Central Tax field formations; State GST formations may issue similar instructions, and no separate Meghalaya State instruction was located in the official public sources searched. The statutory document-carrying requirement in section 68 remains distinct from the instruction's transit-interception procedures. Current-affairs items were checked against Meghalaya I&PR PR Nos. 182/26, 181/26, 180/26 and 175/26, the official NEC October fund-release PDF and the Government FOCUS Plus release. The EUFF question uses the post-screening Government release, which confirms the 31st edition and the 12–18 November Shillong run. Additional current-law review on 2026-11-24 covered Finance Act 2026 sections 153–155 effective 2026-11-01; Notification 05/2026-Central Tax (G.S.R. 919(E)) and its 2026-11-18 corrigendum; the 2026-11-20 GSTN Metro Rail mode update; and Meghalaya Taxation Department's official GST notification index. Question 9430 is CGST Act section 62, not CGST Rules rule 62(5). No 2026 Meghalaya State Tax instruction corresponding to CBIC Instruction 02/2026 was visible in the public index checked; this is recorded as an evidence limitation, not proof of absence. The Notification 05/2026 Gazette text was reviewed from a hosted copy because its direct CBIC portal record was not retrieved; the 18 November corrigendum was linked from the official CBIC tax-information portal. The Metro Rail advisory item is supporting context from a secondary tax update, not a question in this batch.
